title: Dual-Adaptive Z-Score PPO: Dynamic Clipping Using Action Confidence and Normalized Advantage Magnitude
abstract: arXiv:2610.32194v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) remains a popular on-policy reinforcement learning algorithm owing to its stability and ease of implementation. Its clipping threshold, however, is fixed, so every training sample receives the same trust-region width regardless of how reliable the corresponding policy update is. This work examines adaptive-clipping variants of PPO in which the constant clipping parameter is replaced by sample-dependent thresholds computed from policy and return statistics. The central method, Dual-Adaptive Z-Score PPO (PPO-DAZ3), sets the clipping interval for each sample from two signals: action confidence, given by the probability of the selected action under the current policy, and update confidence, given by the normalized advantage magnitude. translated_title: 双自适应Z分数PPO：基于动作置信度与归一化优势幅度的动态裁剪
translated_abstract: 近端策略优化（PPO）因其稳定性和易于实现而仍然是一种流行的在线策略强化学习算法。然而，其裁剪阈值是固定的，因此每个训练样本都获得相同的信任域宽度，而不论相应策略更新的可靠程度如何。本工作研究了PPO的自适应裁剪变体，将恒定的裁剪参数替换为基于策略和回报统计量为每个样本计算的阈值。其核心方法——双自适应Z分数PPO（PPO-DAZ3）——利用两个信号为每个样本设置裁剪区间：动作置信度（由当前策略下所选动作的概率给出）和更新置信度（由归一化优势幅度给出），而标准PPO训练流程的其余部分保持不变。在三个经典控制基准（LunarLander-v3、CartPole-v1和Acrobot-v1）上的评估表明……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PPO-DAZ3方法，通过动作置信度和归一化优势幅度这两个信号为每个样本动态设置PPO的裁剪阈值，同时保持标准PPO训练流程其余部分不变。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PPO-DAZ3, which dynamically sets the PPO clipping threshold for each sample using two signals—action confidence and normalized advantage magnitude—while leaving the rest of the standard PPO training pipeline unchanged.
